notes.title: Languages
notes.content:
Hello everybody, 

Since the beta of the 2.0, the game was exclusively in English. With this update, it is opened to every language (with european letters and without any special characters, the font used for the game won't accept any).

- French language added
- added the possibility to add any language
- bug fixed : the arrows are not disappearing inversaly to the minimum / maximum option in the option menu if you click on it with the mouse

If you speak more than one language, you are free (and it would in fact be very appreciated) to add more languages. It should take you around 10 minutes.

To do this, all you have to do is to look into the game fileholder:
C:\Users\Username\AppData\Local\Suprapong

Open the file languages.ini then under [languages_names] add a line with a number greater than the other languages with the name of the new language in English (with the first letter as a capital letter).
For example :
2="Spanish"

Then, copy-paste the "menus" file of your choice to use it as a base and change its name depending of the new language.
Example :
- copy-paste -> "menus_English.txt"
- Change its name in "menus_Spanish.txt"

Open the renamed file and translate any text on the right side of the "=" (between " ") and don't touch anything between the [ ].
If you change something on the left side of the "=" this part will automatically come back into English language ingame.

To send me that new language you're proud of, you can send that new "menus" file through discord. At the same time, why don't you join our community ?
[url=https://discord.gg/qeBE4zpkD4]discord link[/url]

I hope you enjoy these news, I'm gonna wish you a merry Christmas,

Have suprafun !

notes.title: Survival
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we release the last version of Suprapong in Beta. If you want to access the beta, the password is : suprapongbeta

This update includes :

- a lot of bug fixes
- some graphical improvements in trail effects
- some optimisations

but more important, 2 new options that you could previously see but not activate are now live :
- Survival (in the launching menu) : when a player reach 0 HP, instead of bringing you to the score screen you'll know see him be kicked out and the game will continue. If the last real player loose or if there is only 1 players left it will of course end the game.

- Accelerating ball (in the game options) : each time the ball bounces on something, its speed will increase by 4%. In 10 bounces, its base speed and smash speed will increase by 40% !

These are optional and are deactivated by default. If you want them, don't forget to activate them !

Don't forget to use the new "ball effect" system ! 
RB / LB on gamepad, A / E by default on the keyboard when you touch a ball.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816433/5ef8f5094ccbdc51e8be935b47e5f5c5a8b7850c.png[/img]

An improvement of the spells selection : you can now see the list of the spells by validating the selected spell, making it faster and easier to find the spell you are looking for.

You can now see a list of the controls in the menu. Also, key rebinding is available (only for the keyboard as we are quite happy with gamepad controls).

This update brings us closer to the final release of this beta version. Don't forget to report bugs on our discord or sharing your thought / ideas.
-> https://discord.gg/Zera3MV

Here is a little list of some small changes in this version you might be interested in :
- most of the spells creating something (wormhole, bumper...) now last longer
- wormholes are now twice bigger, touching the ball more often
- in the wormhole game mode, the wormholes now rotate in a different way. Hard to explain but you'll see that ingame. Tell us if you like it that way !
- the bumper game mode have seen his number of bumpers increased from 7 to 9 (it might not seem to be a lot but keep in mind it increases the chances to touch something on the border by 50%, you'll notice the difference)
- the ball trails have been reduced to prevent them from being too long with speed increase
- whatever their speed the balls trails will now look more like a line than separated spots
- fixed a bug with teleporting IA
- the controls adapt to the player's position


Supracheers !

notes.title: Suprapong Update 1.15
notes.content:
A new update is here !
Many many many changes, from small to medium ones.

As always, you can report bugs to us or give us some ideas on the discord at this address :
https://discord.gg/Zera3MV
Find players to play with, to play online is possible with Parsec !

If you want to help us and get an access to the latest build, if you don't fear bugs and crash you may activate the beta option on Steam without any password. Same as above, please report any problem you can face in the discord in the "bugs" section.

Changes :
- You can now play with a gamepad AND the keyboard ! It was a hard one, but many asked for it. We replaced the "Skin" button of the launching menu by a gamepad / gamepad + keyboard option.
- The mouse disappear if a gamepad is plugged and you don't move it for a short time. A fix for lazy people, like me.
- 4 "basic" option slots already configured for the new players. Noob / bomb / bumper / umadbro (you mad bro) sets, the titles should give you a clue. For the players who already have a save, we don't change it to not erase slots you already configured. Noob is a bigger racquet and slower balls, bomb is 2 balls (little trick to add some strategy !), bumper have a slower bomb that slow down after an acceleration and smashes are also slower. The last option set almost everything up (or down, it depends).
- some changes in the descriptions of spells or options to make it easier and not let some text be above another. Description of the game modes is now lower.
- a black background now hides the star background in menus when possible when there is text for an easier reading
- Smash animation visually updated
- Glue appearing / disappearing animation is faster and more fluid
- visually upgraded the ... thing that creates electricity in the goals
- The lootbox now opens faster and is more fluid
- Glue and frozen sound have been reduced while the ball hitting a racquet have been increased.
- The globule will now release the ball if the ball hits something
- A new pause menu system, this should avoid some problems that could happen with the background. New animations too !
- New animations when you change options in the launching menu.
- Animation when you change your spell centralized on the spells.
- Changing the customization of the racquet with a skin will now unequip the skin for a better flow in the customization. To get your skin back, just go back to the skin section. You don't have to validate anything, what you see on your player is what you get ingame.
- Slight increase of the smash area
- optimization on the glue spell
- glue can't be invered anymore if you wait the 2 seconds and let the ball leave without be smashed 

Changes in the launching menu :
- Player 1 no longer need to be selected with the skin button to be customized with the mouse
- Player 1 can switch between the menu and the customization directly by pressing X with a gamepad. Note that you can't change your spells with the gamepad if you are not in the customization with player 1.
- Colors always appear for the player 1 to be able to select them directly with the mouse
- RB and LB appear on the buttons only if you can use the gamepad to activate them
- A rectangle now shows you the selected option for the special rules (how points are calculated, type of game and type of ball) for more clarity, especially with the mouse.
- B and X are not anymore on the spells in the hope people will stop press them to change spells.
- Customization interfaces now tells you what you can do depending of the situation like : "press x to enter customization" or "press A to select a color"
- To press Y with a gamepad, R with the keyboard while in the customization will give you a random customized racquet with random colors !

Bugs corrections :
- Arrows don't become pink in menus anymore when you use the pad in the customization
- Fixed a crash in the customization
- Particles no longer appear above the players
- Fixed a bug with the gamepad while switching between the options slots in game options that would reset the options of the slots
- Changing option slots in the launching menu with a gamepad now work as intended.
- You can no longer click on colors when you pick a spell wit the mouse
- Spells now appear in a black rectangle above the colors when you click on them
- Customization arrows now follow the change of the number of players in the launching menu
- 1st spell do not exchange with the 2nd spell anymore between the menu and the game
- multiple other fixes
- multiple minor optimizations
- The Dontpass spell isn't wrote above other text anymore. That's the most important change I think.
- Moved some text that was going over skins slots in the launching menu.

- Solo history mode added ! Play the racquet in an unforgiven world where your enemies are not always the ones you think. Discover the betrayal of the ball and how the racquet lost his wife and son and took the path of revenge. Fight in the arena to reach the one who killed them and become the Lord of the Balls ! Oh April the 1st is over ? Damn it. Dare tell me it would not be awesome !

notes.title: Major Update coming this week
notes.content:
What's new :
- 3 new spells
- Game options slots
- Cumulative game modes
- More animations in the launching menu
- Players order in the launching menu now match their ingame position
- A lot of new animations in the launching menu
- Bug fixes

Details :
Spells
- Icezone will freeze a small area for a limited time. Every ball passing through will be slowed down.
- Glue can be deactivated anytime if it hasn't been used. The next ball(s) touching the racquet (smash won't count) will stick to it and will be released on smash or after 3 seconds.
- Chain will send a harpoon in the direction of the center of the room. If it touches a ball, it changes its direction to the player's direction (hard to use but small cooldown, try to redirect the ball on a bumper and look at the stupid face your mate(s) will make !).

Game options slot
You can now select different slot in the game options (or in the launching menu). Every slot will save every game options you set and you can rename them by right clicking on it. Click the "+" slot to add a new slot and the X in the top hand right corner to delete one.
For example, let's say you create a game option slot called "noob" with a ball at 70% speed, players at 135% size, etc. If you select this slot under the game option button in the launching menu, these options will apply and you don't have to change every option at the beginning of each game ! Customize your favorite options and save them in a slot to enjoy them quickly !

New animations in the launching menu
- changing the number of players now move the players to their next position instead of teleporting them
- selecting different options and moving around will move a pink button, showing you what you are selecting to help you understand how the menu works. 
- changing racquet's customizations will now play a small animation
- at player's apparition, everything will make a small jump. Best feature ever. You're welcome !

Cumulative game modes
Before, Suprapong, Bomb, Chaos, Bumper, Protect were 5 separated game modes. Now you can mix them as followed :
- Game mode : changes the arena (bumper / chaos / classic)
- Ball mode : changes the ball (normal / bomb)
- Score mode : aggressive or defensive. 
Aggressive gives the point to the last guy (that isn't the guy's side where the goal was made) who touched the ball. If you score a goal or miss the ball and it enters your side and nobody touched it before you, you get a "shame point" (it appears in your score bar) that will decrease your score at the end of the game. If you get a victory with 10 points with 2 shame point, you finally have scored only 8 points. If one of your friends got 9, he beats you. Yeah, that's the game so don't be a noob, don't miss the ball at the beginning.
Defensive : Everyone begin with the maximum score (between 1 and 50 depending of the game options you set) and loose 1 if the ball enters your side (or explodes, who knows ?). The game end when a player reach 0. No shame points here but shame is on you if you loose.

Others
- More indications of what you are doing in the launching menu, for example it tells you "press A to change colors" while colors aren't selected and "press A to validate colors" when colors are selected.
- You can now change the player 1 customization without needing to click on "Customization" first (appearance and colors). It still need to be selected with the pad or the keyboard.
- Launching menu options are now changed with LB / RB buttons instead of the arrows on the pad because of the new "cumulative game modes" system. I guess you'll understand why when you'll change the game modes.
- Optimization when you add / remove players in the launching menu 

Bug fixes
- many many many ! (I don't have the detail for these ones)
- Anti-Aliasing now work as intended, no more pixelated moonlight

notes.title: Next Update

Hello,

We don't like to let you without news for too long and even if we would like to keep some surprises, I can tell you we are preparing a [b]huge[/b] update (there will be more than fixes this time).

So what can you expect ? Many changes I won't list here but to talk about the big ones :
[list]
[*] New powers
[*] New animations in menus and in customisation
[*] Position of the players of the launching menu will now be the same than ingame (we hope people will feel less... lost with this change)
[*] Options slots !
[/list]

Let me explain this "option slots" : 
You will soon be able to create game options slots and give them a name. These options will save all the custom game options you want.
Let's say you create a slot called "newbie" with player size at 135%, ball size at 120%, arena size at 90% and ball speed at 85%. If you select this slot, all these options will be applied ingame and you won't need to change them all one by one before each game.

We keep some suprises and fixes (I'm looking at you anti aliasing). We are working on some stuff I won't spoil here but that might come with this update or later.

We hope you will enjoy the additions !

notes.title: Suprapong & online multiplayer
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It isn't just because Christmas is near, we always wanted to make an online multiplayer for Suprapong.

The reason why we did not do it was because we wanted it to be competitive but online is tricky and any lag break all the fun. If you see the ball going through your racket, there is no way you would say "oh it's fine, no problem" and keep playing.

Still, there are some good news, there is Parsec, a software we discovered not so long ago and if your internet is good enough [b]you can play to Suprapong online[/b] !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33816433/169568cb261868bf352168a6eb3d4d265765f39c.jpg[/img]

All you have to do is :
[list]
[*] create an account [url=https://ui.parsecgaming.com/signup]here[/url]
[*] Download Parsec [url=https://parsecgaming.com/downloads]here[/url] ([b]it's free[/b] !)
[*] Add your friends on Parsec
[*] To host, click on "Enable Hosting".
[*] plug your pad(s) and you can play (of course your friends will have to do all these steps too)
[/list]

If you have any issues with Parsec, you can chat with them on their discord [url=https://discord.gg/cQjEGFy]here[/url]

Sooo... Merry Christmas !

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.02
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes 1.02 :[/b][/h1]
-Better automatic detection of the size of the screen the first time you launch the game
-Fixed bugs between full screen changes
-Fixed bugs between resolution changes
-Some minor optimisations in menus, while launching a game and ingame
-Optimisation of the falling star's particles in the "star" map
-Optimisation of the ball if there is 2 or more
-Fixed unplugging the pad while in the pause menu creating a second pause menu on the first one (and was quite buggy)
-X and B aren't inverted anymore for the player at the bottom of the screen in 1v1
-Spells now correctly save when launching the game by using a pad or the keyboard
-Fixed a crash that could occur with pads in the launch menu
-Fixed Back to Main Menu and Game Options button in the launching menu, they now work with the pad and the keyboard
-French back button in the game options menu doesn't show a 0 anymore
-Correction of the French description for the bumper spell
